description: Defines constants, structures, and functions for parsing and handling X.509 distinguished names and attribute type-value pairs in ASN.1 DER encoding, as used in certificate parsing within the Chromium project.

classes.name: X509NameAttribute
classes.description: Represents a DER-encoded attribute type and value in an X.509 distinguished name, with methods for conversion and formatting.

methods.name: ValueAsString
methods.description: Converts the attribute value to a UTF-8 string if possible.

methods.name: ValueAsStringWithUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Converts the attribute value to a UTF-8 string with configurable handling options.

methods.name: ValueAsStringUnsafe
methods.description: Converts the attribute value to a string without verification of encoding.

methods.name: AsRFC2253String
methods.description: Formats the attribute as an RFC2253-compliant string.
